Day 11 (old art) - August 2015 (age 12)

over the course of posting these I've been noticing a few things

I used to love and still do designing characters

I never end up using them for anything lol

I didn't draw as regularly as I remembered

now the last point I find really interesting. I don't post every single drawing I found and I sadly don't have access to my old digital art since my laptop kinda imploded from all the viruses I downloaded (oops)

but in my head I was drawing every day and that doesn't seem to be accurate

of course there's nothing wrong with only drawing sometimes, but it would explain why I plateau'd so hard (along with the fact that I didn't really leave my comfort zone a lot)

Just thought it was interesting how we are very unreliable narrators of our own stories and how years later we notice things we never did

Life is full of surprises!
